text:
kevin: Heads-up — console is showing version 'flapping' alerts for some tenants. v1/v2 traffic attribution jumps back and forth every ~5m, which is tripping the deprec banner churn. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: I saw a spike in the dashboard earlier, thought it was a telemetry lag. Can you paste the panel query? link? :eyes: 

kevin: https://grafana/redwood/d/abcd/version-metrics
kevin: query snippet: 
```
max_over_time(route_version[5m]) by (tenant)
sum(rate(requests_total[1m])) by (route, version)
```
kevin: looks like sampling + sudden tiny bursts flip the max_over_time window.

sam: Probable cause: client header jitter + our version-handshake fallback. Some clients resend with no version header and console heuristics prefer v1. When the client retries quickly, the short window flips.

sam: Quick repro: run a burst of requests where ~3% strip headers, you get an oscillation on the 1m/5m panels.

priya: UX/console options: we should avoid showing a deprec banner on volatile signals. Suggestion: add a 'stable_for' metric: only show deprec badge if version pinned/stable for >= 15m and traffic share > 10%. Also debounce the banner in UI (2-minute cooldown).

maria: Agreed on debounce. For telemetry we can emit a new label `version_confidence` (low/medium/high) derived from consistent windowed signals. That will help dashboards and alerts.

kevin: I'll prototype adding a smoothing aggregation on the panel: `rolling_stddev(rate(...), 5m)` and a `traffic_share` threshold. Should reduce noise.

alert-bot: [auto-alert] version-flap: tenant=acme, fluctuations=7 in last 10m, severity=informational

sam: Ops note: this also affects quota attribution triggers (we switch quota buckets on version flip). Might cause double-counting. Need to ensure billing pipeline uses a stabilized version tag (use majority in 10m).

priya: Good catch. I'll add a console proposal: 
- UI: debounce banner, show `version_confidence` tooltip, add link to raw events 
- Telemetry: emit `version_stable_until` + confidence label 
- Billing: use 10m majority for attribution, ignore flips shorter than 30s

kevin: Can we stage this as a dashboard change + non-blocking backend label first? I'd like to roll the dashboard smoothing this afternoon and watch for noise drop.

maria: I'll add a temporary dashboard annotation to mark when smoothing deploys, so we can compare.

sam: Also suggest a probe test in CI that simulates header-strip bursts so we don't regress.

priya: I'll file a short RFC and add the UX mock. TL;DR: don't nag users for flapping signals.

kevin: Thanks — will deploy panel tweak now and follow up with the RFC link. :thumbsup:
